biography: Ellen Lohr, a name whispered with excitement in the German motorsport scene, hails from a small village nestled in the Black Forest. Her journey began not on asphalt, but on the icy slopes of a local ski resort. At age 10, she won a local ski race and used the prize money to buy a used go-kart. What started as a hobby quickly became an obsession. Weekends were spent tearing around makeshift tracks, honing her skills. At 16, she was accepted into a prestigious young driver program sponsored by AMG Mercedes, where her raw talent and fearless driving style immediately caught the eye of team managers. After a stint in Formula Ford where she secured two victories and several podium finishes, Lohr made the jump to the fiercely competitive DTM series, signing with AMG Mercedes Berlin2000. Despite facing seasoned veterans, she has already shown flashes of brilliance, securing a podium finish at the Norisring and establishing herself as a force to be reckoned with. The future looks bright for this young German talent, and the racing world eagerly awaits to see what she accomplishes next.
drivingStyle: Ellen Lohr is known for her aggressive and flamboyant driving style. She attacks corners with a seemingly reckless abandon, often pushing the limits of grip to gain an advantage. While this approach can lead to spectacular overtakes, it also makes her prone to occasional errors. She's not afraid to trade paint and thrives in wheel-to-wheel battles. While tire management is still a work in progress, her natural car control and bravery behind the wheel make her a constant threat on the track.

careerHighlight: Securing a surprise podium finish at the Norisring in her debut DTM season, battling experienced veterans and showcasing her overtaking prowess.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead at Hockenheimring after a late-race collision with Klaus Richter, costing her a potential first victory.
